beats.stage: A candlelit anniversary dinner at home. Tom raises his glass. Linda suddenly pushes back her chair, nearly tipping hers. He catches it.
lines: Tom. I’m sorry. I can’t do this.
beats.purpose: Start with a charged interruption. Open the apparent relationship crisis before revealing the physical problem.
beats.cut: Catch the glass, then cut to Tom watching her leave.

beats.stage: She disappears down the hall. Tom lowers his glass.
lines: I hadn’t even started the speech.
beats.purpose: A small, wounded joke establishes his personality and keeps the opening from feeling melodramatic.
beats.cut: Hold the empty chair briefly; bridge into his footsteps.

beats.stage: He stops outside the closed bathroom door.
lines: Then why do you keep leaving?
beats.purpose: Voice the viewer’s question and establish that this has happened before.
beats.cut: Shot/reverse-shot across the door, then hold on her before the admission.

beats.stage: Inside, Linda sits on the closed toilet lid in her anniversary dress. She presses a tissue beneath one eye.
lines: Because I’m bloated all the time. I can barely go to the bathroom. Since I started the shot, every dinner feels like a gamble.
beats.purpose: Pay off the opening mystery with a private fact. Her dress carries the conflict between the evening she wanted and the evening she is having.
beats.cut: Stay with her admission; cut to his face when his interpretation changes.

beats.stage: She looks at herself in the mirror. The earrings he gave her catch the light.
lines: I wanted you to look at me in this dress. Not picture me stuck in here.
I thought you didn’t want our evenings anymore.
beats.purpose: Explain the secrecy and show the personal cost. The earrings establish that she remembered and cared.
beats.cut: Use one earring/mirror detail, then return to the doorway; avoid repeated symptom shots.

beats.stage: Linda opens the door. Tom’s expression softens.
lines: I wanted to lose the weight. I didn’t want to lose our evenings.
Then let’s stop pretending you’re fine.
beats.purpose: State the desired identity and emotional objective before any product. His response changes the next action from concealment to support.
beats.cut: Hold them together in the doorway; a gentle dissolve acknowledges the next day.

beats.stage: The next morning. Linda finishes a call to her prescriber and joins Tom at the kitchen table.
lines: I finally called. My medication can slow how fast food leaves my stomach. Bloating and constipation can be side effects.
And you thought you just had to live with it?
I thought I wasn’t supposed to complain.
beats.purpose: Introduce a supported explanation and undo the assumption that symptoms must be hidden. The prescriber is not shown endorsing a supplement.
beats.cut: Begin with the completed call, then follow the exchange; preserve a pause after her last line.

beats.stage: He slides her coffee closer and sits beside her.
lines: You can be happy about your progress and still ask for help.
beats.purpose: Resolve the belief that gratitude for progress means accepting every difficulty silently.
beats.cut: Hold the shared frame, then a clear later-time transition.

beats.stage: Later, during her morning routine. Linda sets a Motilli bottle beside her water glass.
lines: Motilli. Celery juice gummies. I wanted something simple to add to my daily routine.
You know how I feel about swallowing pills.
beats.purpose: Make product choice hers. Introduce the concrete format and its practical appeal without claiming it reverses medication effects.
beats.cut: Reveal the actual approved pack when named; return to her dry smile for the pill line.

beats.stage: A later date night. The same earrings, the same table. Linda gets up. Tom looks worried for a moment.
lines: You can tell me while we dance.
beats.purpose: Repeat the opening action with a new meaning. Close the relationship loop through communication and connection, not a claim that a gummy produced immediate relief.
beats.cut: Echo the opening angle, pause on his worried look, then reveal her hand reaching for his.

beats.stage: They dance, a little awkwardly, in the kitchen. End on the Motilli pack.
lines: A little care for your everyday. Meet Motilli.
beats.purpose: Leave the viewer with the relationship payoff and a clear brand invitation.
beats.cut: Allow the first dance movement to complete; clean cut to a readable pack and getmotilli.com.
